05 · Free vs paid — "H3 free nahi hai?" ka poora jawab
27 Oct 2026. Prices/promos badalte hain — quote se pehle re-check karo.
1. Seedha jawab
MiniMax-H3 free nahi hai. H3 ke do hi raste hain:


Route
	Free?
	Kya milta hai
	H3 API (platform.minimax.io)
	❌ paid per second
	768P $0.08/s · 2K $0.13/s · native 32 kHz stereo audio
	H3 open weights (local)
	✅ weights free (licence ke tehat)
	lekin GPU chahiye: 4×H100 class, ya pruned INT8 + 1×80 GB / 16–24 GB slow. 768P only
	Hailuo web app (hailuoai.video)
	⚠️ trial only
	ek-baar welcome credits (~150–200), 3 din me expire, watermark, 768p, commercial use nahi. Promo: MiniMax Design app install par 3 free H3 trials + 3,000 credits
	fal.ai H3-Max
	⚠️ promo
	signed-in users ke liye roz 5 free generations (768p, 15 s tak) — promo, guarantee nahi
	Fully free forever
	✅
	H3 nahi — Wan 2.1 / Wan 2.2 / LTX-Video (Apache-2.0 / community licence) apne ya Colab GPU par
	

API ka "free tier" jo docs me dikhta hai woh rate limit hai (2 concurrent tasks), clip allowance nahi.
2. Toh free me kya chal sakta hai (Colab T4 = 16 GB)
Model

	Output
	Audio
	Ek 5 s clip ka waqt
	Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B (diffusers, Apache-2.0)
	✅ comfortable (offload + VAE tiling)
	832×480, 81 frames @16 fps
	❌ silent
	~8–25 min
	Wan 2.1 T2V 14B
	⚠️ GGUF/offload, slow
	480p
	❌
	40 min+
	Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B
	❌ fp16 ~22 GB peak; fp8 T4 par nahi
	720p
	❌
	—
	LTX-Video 2B distilled
	✅ ~6 GB
	512–704p, short
	❌ (LTX-2.3 me audio, magar 16 GB+ NVFP4)
	~3–8 min
	LTX-2.3 22B (audio)
	❌ 24 GB+ NVFP4/Blackwell class
	up to 4K
	✅
	—
	MiniMax-H3-Base
	❌ ~100–128 GB resident
	768p
	✅
	—
	

T4 ki technical wajah: Turing (sm_75) — bfloat16 nahi, FP8/NVFP4 nahi, ~16 GB VRAM. Is liye naye models jo bf16/Blackwell maangte hain woh T4 par nahi chalte. float16 + CPU offload + VAE tiling = 16 GB ka rasta.


Yeh notebook ready hai: ../colab/MONARCH_T4_FREE_BRIDGE.ipynb (model load → jobs → render → mp4 Drive me → receipts + optional Drive job queue).
3. "Ping / URL" pattern ka sach
Pichle agent ne colab_gpu_bridge_v2.ipynb diya tha: Colab par ek URL banta tha, aur woh bolta tha "URL mujhe khud mil jayega — aap so jao". Us pattern ke teen masle hain:


1. Colab ToS: free tier interactive use ke liye hai. Remote-control/SSH/server banana allowed nahi — session/account band ho sakta hai. Paid Colab bhi server hosting ke liye nahi hai.
2. Security: quick tunnel (trycloudflare) URL public hota hai; token na ho to koi bhi aap ke GPU par job chala sakta hai, ya aap ke Drive paths padh sakta hai.
3. Is sandbox se main us URL tak nahi pohanchta — yahan sirf github/npm/pypi allow hain. Is liye main tunnel par job bhej nahi sakta; aap khud browser/curl se bhejenge.


Safe alternative jo wahi kaam karta hai: Drive-based job queue (notebook cell 8). Aap phone se jobs.json edit karo → Colab utha leta hai → status.json + mp4 + receipts.json Drive me. No public URL, no ToS problem, aur laptop band hone se kuch nahi bigadta (Colab chalta rehta hai jab tak session zinda hai; woh bhi 90 min idle/12 ghante par khatam hota hai — yeh free ki asli limit hai).


Agar 24/7 worker chahiye: RunPod / Vast.ai par 1× RTX 4090 ya A100 rent karo ($0.3–1.5/hr), wahan tunnel wala pattern bhi legally theek hai. Colab free us kaam ke liye galat tool hai.
4. Cost-minimising production mix (recommended)
DRAFT / PLATES  → free (T4 notebook): Wan/LTX silent clips, composition + camera lock


HERO SHOTS      → paid (H3 API): 5 s 768P $0.40 · 5 s 2K $0.65, native dialogue + stereo audio


FINISH          → WF-05: voice/music mix, typography, transitions, 24→30 fps conform


* Ek 60 s film: 6 hero shots 2K = $7.80 (+retries ~$12) + 6 free plates = $0.
* Pehle free me composition lock karo — phir paid shot me sirf wohi angle banao jo final hai. Yahi asli bachat hai.
* Wan clips silent hote hain, is liye H3 ke bina dialogue/lipsync ka kaam nahi hota — us hisse ke liye H3 hi.
5. Free route ke rules (notebook me lagaye gaye)
1. MAX_JOBS cap (default 8) — ek session me zyada jobs = disconnect par sab zaya.
2. Har clip Drive me + receipts.json (prompt, seed, steps, render seconds, md5).
3. frames must be 4k+1 (81 = 5 s @16 fps); notebook khud fix karta hai.
4. OOM par height/width/frames kam karo, steps na badhao.
5. Tunnel cell default OFF; chalu karo to strong token + AUTO_STOP_MIN lazmi.
6. Free clips ko commercial deliverable ki tarah mat becho — Wan Apache-2.0 hai (theek), magar Colab ke free tier par production rendering bhi ToS ka grey area hai. Client delivery ke liye rented GPU behtar.
